# aether_cluster_volumes (Data Source)

The persistent volumes of a cluster from the platform's storage inventory, sorted by `id`. When `inventory_available` is false the platform could not read the storage inventory and `volumes` is empty — not a statement that the cluster has no volumes.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) UUID of the cluster.

### Read-Only

- `inventory_available` (Boolean) False when the platform could not read a current storage inventory; `volumes` is then empty.
- `last_synced_at` (String) When the organization's inventory last completed a full sync (RFC 3339); the zero time when `inventory_available` is false.
- `org_shared_quota_bytes` (Number) Quota of the organization-wide shared-storage pool, which every cluster of the organization shares; `0` means unlimited/unset.
- `org_shared_used_bytes` (Number) Bytes in use in that organization-wide pool (not the sum of this cluster's volumes).
- `volumes` (Attributes List) The cluster's volumes, sorted by `id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volumes))

<a id="nestedatt--volumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `volumes`

Read-Only:

- `billed_on` (String) Which figure the volume is billed on: `provisioned` or `used`.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) CSI volume handle (block) or subvolume name (shared).
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `provisioned_bytes` (Number) Image size (block) or subvolume quota (shared); for a shared volume `0` means an unlimited quota, not an empty volume.
- `state` (String) State as reported by the platform.
- `storage_class` (String) `aether-block` or `aether-shared`.
- `type` (String) `block` or `shared`.
- `used_bytes` (Number) Bytes in use.
- `used_percent` (Number) Used over provisioned, in percent; unclamped, and `0` when provisioned is `0`.
- `watchers` (Number) Open block-device watchers (`0` = nothing has the image mapped).
